title: CenteraBeat
tagline: An AI auditor of centralization risks of any DeFi contract, checks for any admin keys.
description:
Process
1. Enter an address into CenteraBeat
2. Downloads source code for contract if is verified on Etherscan.
3. Audits solidity code for any admin keys
4. Check if any timelocks, multisigs or other resitrctions.
5. Also checks if there are any limits to what admin key can do.
6. Presents this data to the user in plaintext clearly.
how_its_made:
This was mostly vibecoded.
 - Contract code from etherscan
- Claude API from LLM analysis of contract code
- Vercel AI SDK
- Typescript logic.
- All implemented in frontend for now
- Only checks single contract for now, could have it check the complete DeFI deployment for proper understanding. Could also pregenerate and generate a L2Beat like list of top 100 DeFi protocols.
